submitted.rationale: EQE increases steadily with Fe content: 0.0050% at Fe0.51 (FeSbO4 stoichiometry), 0.025% at Fe0.76, and 0.055% at Fe0.81. The Fe-rich end, where Fe2O3 absorbs at 2.7 eV, performs best. Index 0 is the most Fe-rich composition in the library.
